# Contextify contributor context

## Commands
- Run the drift and writer fixtures with `python3 tests/test_ctx_check.py`.
- Run claim resolver fixtures with `python3 tests/test_verify_claims.py`.
- Check manifests and required files with `python3 tests/test_manifests.py`.
- Check the skill contract with `python3 evals/check_skill.py skills/contextify/SKILL.md`.
- Check this repository's context with `sh skills/contextify/scripts/ctx-check`.

## Architecture
- `skills/contextify/SKILL.md` orchestrates evidence reading and a separate verifier; `skills/contextify/scripts/ctx_write.py` applies drafts.
- `skills/contextify/scripts/ctxlib.py` contains shared claim resolvers, evidence normalizers and managed-block handling used by `skills/contextify/scripts/ctx_check.py`.
- `hooks/hooks.json` calls the deterministic checker at Claude session start; hooks report drift without rewriting context.

## Repository workflow
- `.github/workflows/validate.yml` runs the Python checks on pushes and pull requests.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` publishes tags beginning with v and checks the version against `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
- Keep scripts dependency-free and omit AI attribution trailers from commits; see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Read when relevant
- `docs/design/SCRIPTS-SPEC.md` defines script contracts; `docs/design/DECISIONS.md` records product decisions.
- `skills/contextify/references/update-in-place.md` defines preservation and conflict behavior.
